# REMO World (https://remoworld.com)

> REMO World is a free bilingual (English & French) 4D Focus TV City Window, Synced Lofi Study Room platform, 4D City Social Network, Live World Radio Player (56 ad-free global & Lofi stations across 24/24 cities), Daily World Blitz 60s Geography Trivia with 1v1 Friend Duels, Guess My City photo game, and 9:16 Virtual Boarding Pass Generator connecting 24 world cities in real time.

## Key Free Features (Zero Sign-Up Required to Explore)
- [REMO World Live Social App](https://remoworld.com/): Real-time cross-city social feed, live City Wars, Citizen Passports, and collectible 4D City Cards.
- [4D Focus TV — Ambient City Windows & Zen Clock](https://remoworld.com/focus-tv.html): Fullscreen 4D Focus TV window with rain/snow/neon/fireplace FX, Fly Random teleportation, Live Rain/Night city filters, Custom Vibe Links (`?tv=city&fx=rain`), and Minimal Zen Desk Clock mode.
- [Synced Study Together Rooms](https://remoworld.com/study-room.html): Shareable Focus Together Room URLs (`?tv=tokyo&fx=rain&room=study42`) with synchronized Pomodoro sessions and ad-free Lofi radio.
- [Daily World Blitz 60s & 1v1 Duels](https://remoworld.com/world-blitz.html): 5 daily world cities solved in 60 seconds with shareable Wordle-style result cards and URL-encoded 1v1 challenge links (`?open=blitz&vs=...`).
- [Free Live World Cities Radio (56 Stations)](https://remoworld.com/world-radio.html): Stream live radio from Paris, Montréal, Chișinău (8 live stations), Bucharest, New York, London, Tokyo, Seoul, Berlin, Dubai, Lisbon, Amsterdam, Sydney, Rio, Singapore & Cairo + Lofi, Jazz & Synthwave.
- [Guess The City Photo Game](https://remoworld.com/guess-the-city.html): Free browser geography & skyline photo guessing game created by real citizens worldwide.
- [4D Holographic Boarding Pass Generator](https://remoworld.com/boarding-pass.html): Create & download 9:16 Story Boarding Passes between any two world cities for TikTok, Instagram & WhatsApp.
- [Top 24 World Cities Live Ranking & Duels](https://remoworld.com/world-ranking.html): Real-time city standings and interactive city-vs-city comparison tool ([City Versus](https://remoworld.com/city-versus.html)).
- [All 24 Connected World Cities Directory](https://remoworld.com/cities/index.html): Live local time, weather, radio streams & urban stats for every Edition-1 metropolis.
